title: 10,000 Crop Field Boundaries across India with splits
description:
Release of dataset and neural network weights accompanying the paper
"Unlocking large-scale crop field delineation in smallholder farming systems with transfer learning and weak supervision"
(forthcoming in Remote Sensing). Ten thousand crop fields in India were delineated manually through inspection
of high-resolution satellite imagery (Airbus SPOT). We also provide the weights of the highest performing
neural network (FracTAL ResUNet architecture) pre-trained in France and fine-tuned on Airbus SPOT images in India.
The model was trained in MXNet 1.6.0 and can be loaded with the "model.load_parameters()" function.

This collection holds 1 edition (2020), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/in_10k_ml/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2020). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:4326). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/in_10k_ml/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are mapped: an authority delineated them from imagery or survey, with no farmer's declaration behind them.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: split
table:columns.description: Source-specific column; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: The year the boundaries represent (the season, declaration or snapshot year). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: India 10k with splits — latest edition (2020) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2020/in_10k_ml-2020.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.1, 0.25, 0.5 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
